hitem3d/hi3d/split.description: Split a 3D model into parts with Hi3D.

mesh_url.description: URL of the input model to split. GLB, STL and OBJ formats are supported, up to 200MB.

export_format.description: File format of the generated model. Character split currently supports only 'glb'.

model.title: Model
model.description: Split model type: 'character' splits humanoid models using a template with optional joints; 'general' splits any model by granularity level.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

joint.title: Joint
joint.description: Joint type added between character parts (used when model is 'character').

part.title: Part
part.description: Character split template (used when model is 'character'): 'a' 6 parts, 'b' 5 parts, 'c' 4 parts excluding head, 'd' 4 parts including head, 'e' 3 parts, 'f' 2 parts.

tex_slat_rescale_t.title: Tex Slat Rescale T

texture_size.description: Resolution of the texture image baked onto the mesh. Higher values capture finer surface details but produce larger files.
